Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter - Petition No. 854/2024

Dear Mr. Patil,

Thank you for meeting us on 06/10/2024 about your dispute with Sujata Gaikwad. As we understand it, the wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned. The matter is listed before the Family Court at Kochi.

Our advice is to list the stridhan items to be returned in the settlement deed. Please collect the list of jewellery and gifts with any receipts and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
